# Welcome to Jayan PharmaMed

### Contract Manufacturing

We are one of the leading third party manufacturers, suppliers and exporters of a variety of
Pharmaceutical Medicines like Tablets, Capsules, Syrups, Ointment & Injections, etc., which is
applicable to cure various diseases.

With a 20 year history distributing and manufacturing drugs, peaking with the manufacturing of 1000
million tablets, 200 million capsules, 50 million oral liquid and 10 million of beta lactam dry
syrups, dry injections, we projected that the manufacturing of drugs would move to the country
resulting in intense commodity price and profit deterioration.

Thus, we formed our branded and technology division and have directed most of our R&D budget towards
new branded product development since then. There are number of pharmaceutical companies which do
not have their own manufacturing unit, so that companies are associated with us for third party
pharma manufacturing services.

# Search Jayan PharmaMed Products

[Search Products][42]

**NUMBER SPEAKS**

**We are rapid growing Indian Pharmaceutical Company.**

[Learn More][43]

**Therapies Wise Drugs**

Like Ayurvedic, Contraceptive Agents, Cardiovascular System, Central Nerve System, Diabities,
Gelatin, HIV, Hormones, Herbal, etc.

**Packing Wise Drugs**

Like Injections, Tablets, Capsuls, Lotion / Solution, Cream / Gel, Oinment, Eye / Ear Drops, Liquid
Syrup, Veccine, Vatenary, Suppositories, Kit, etc.

## FOR JAYAN PHARMAMED INDUSTRIES - 'Trained in the Latest Technologies' is much more than just a
## company slogan.

### The name and business strength that has been earned by our organization today, is due to timely
### supply of quality products. In additional, we believe in quality service after sales, looking to
### that we have in house technical support for all products with professionally equipped and able
### staff. State-of-the art highly purified first extract grade gelatin material are developed and
### manufactured in the latest laboratory and production facilities on a floor space of over 30,000
### sq. ft.

## Management Team

The management team comprises of highly qualified chemists, engineers, technologists and marketing
professionals. The management team is making best efforts under the guidance of Mr. Jayesh Patel our
Managing Partner, having 25 years of work experience to achieve customer satisfaction.

## Research & Development

We recognize that product development for current and future needs is must. With a strong emphasis
on research & development, a fully equipped laboratory and our chemists are working hard to respond
to the dental community’s need for better and cheaper products with advanced features.

## Quality Assurance

Our company is committed to consistent quality assurance for all the products which we supply. We
fully stand by the performance guarantee of all our dental clinical products and laboratory
products. We are committed to the implementation of international quality standards to ensure
quality of our products.

## Infrastructure

### We at Jayan Pharmamed offer a multitude of services spanning the entire drug life cycle from
### Drug Discovery & Development, manufacturing and packaging of Clinical Trial Supplies to
### Commercial Manufacturing of Active Pharmaceutical

## ABOUT KMK

KMK CHEMICALS is a leading distributor and an ISO certified company specialized in sourcing and
distributing Active Pharmaceutical Ingredients and Finished Formulations in MENA region, Being a
customer-oriented company, we continuously enlarge our portfolio to be able to offer smart solutions
and to meet most of the requirements of our customers in an easy way. Our team always share their
technical and business insights to our customers for their new and existing products. Knowing the
importance of our suppliers as well, KMK uses advanced ways to facilitate business transactions with
them. We developed our digital channel (KMK Mobile Application) to be able to serve our wide-ranging
networks of suppliers and customers in a smart way.

### Our Mission

Excellence and prevalence in submitting company and customer service’s considering our code of
ethics. Excellence and superiority in professional development and in applying information
technology with the use of capital manpower. Excellence and efficiency in developing the raw
materials industry and in health activities participation that serves the community in the MENA
region.

### Our Vision

KMK’s vision is to empower Pharmaceutical companies by being one of the top five distributors of
Active Pharmaceutical Ingredients and Pharmaceutical Finished formulations in the MENA region . Our
objective is to be perceived as the first choice for our customers when it comes to API & FDF
sourcing.

### Our Values

- Excellence

- Performance

- Integrity

- Accountability

- Market Oriented

## ABOUT KMK

KMK CHEMICALS is a leading distributor and an ISO certified company specialized in sourcing and
distributing Active Pharmaceutical Ingredients and Finished Formulations in MENA region, Being a
customer-oriented company, we continuously enlarge our portfolio to be able to offer smart solutions
and to meet most of the requirements of our customers in an easy way. Our team always share their
technical and business insights to our customers for their new and existing products. Knowing the
importance of our suppliers as well, KMK uses advanced ways to facilitate business transactions with
them. We developed our digital channel (KMK Mobile Application) to be able to serve our wide-ranging
networks of suppliers and customers in a smart way.

### Our Mission

Excellence and prevalence in submitting company and customer service’s considering our code of
ethics. Excellence and superiority in professional development and in applying information
technology with the use of capital manpower. Excellence and efficiency in developing the raw
materials industry and in health activities participation that serves the community in the MENA
region.

### Our Vision

KMK’s vision is to empower Pharmaceutical companies by being one of the top five distributors of
Active Pharmaceutical Ingredients and Pharmaceutical Finished formulations in the MENA region . Our
objective is to be perceived as the first choice for our customers when it comes to API & FDF
sourcing.

### Our Values

- Excellence

- Performance

- Integrity

- Accountability

- Market Oriented

helping patients, friends and families affected by liver disease.

][172]
American Liver Foundation’s (ALF) Liver Life Advocacy Summit was held in Washington, D.C. on April
21st and 22nd and brought together patients, caregivers and families from coast to coast to champion
legislative priorities for liver health and help the 100 million Americans affected by liver
disease.

presented by Bank of America, which takes place on Monday, April 20, 2026, at Hopkinton to Boston.

### American Liver Foundation Elects David Frank as New Board Chair

# Find a Clinical Trial

Clinical trials are research studies that test how well new medical approaches work in people. Speak
with your doctor about the ongoing progress and results of these trials to get the most up-to-date
information on new treatments. Participating in a clinical trial is a great way to contribute to
curing, preventing, and treating liver disease and its complications. **[Start your search
here][178]** to find clinical trials that need people like you.

## Interested in learning more about clinical trials?

Clinical trials are research studies aimed at evaluating medical, surgical, or behavioral
interventions. They are a primary way for researchers to learn more about the safety and
effectiveness of investigational treatments. Check out our featured clinical trials for MASH/NASH
and Hepatocellular Carcinoma (HCC) by clicking below.

[Learn more][179]

## Signature Programs

[

### Think Liver Think Life

][188]
Think Liver Think Life™ is a national public health campaign which aims to ensure every American
understands their risk for liver disease, receives the appropriate screening and care coordination
and feels well-informed and supported throughout their liver journey.
[Visit Website][189]
[

## American Liver Foundation Living Donor Network

][190]
American Liver Foundation’s (ALF) Living Donor Network is the first-ever non-directed liver donor
database; it was created to connect individuals who wish to donate part of their liver with
transplant centers nationwide to help children and adults in need.
[Visit Website][191]
[

## Bili The Brave

][192]
Facing liver disease as a child can be a lonely process for both kids and parents alike, but not
anymore. American Liver Foundation (ALF) is proud to announce the launch of Bili the Brave™ for
children and families affected by biliary atresia (BA).
[Learn More][193]

## Signature Events

[

### Liver Life Walk

][194]
Liver Life Walk is a signature event of the American Liver Foundation (ALF). It allows people
affected by liver disease to come together to raise awareness and funds. It also gives them the
opportunity to support each other in a festive and inspiring environment.
[Visit Website][195]
[

### Liver Life Challenge

][196]
The Liver Life Challenge is the American Liver Foundation’s official endurance program, where
dedicated athletes across the country use their passion and commitment to go the extra mile for the
liver community.
[Visit Website][197]
[

### National Legacy Gala

][198]
The 50th Anniversary National Legacy Gala recognizes individuals and organizations who have made
outstanding contributions to the American Liver Foundation (ALF) and the liver community.
[Visit Website][199]

## Our Impact

We are focused on improving patient lives, increasing public awareness of liver disease, advancing
liver transplantation and funding cutting-edge liver disease research – we’re working every day to
help save lives.
As the largest organization focused on all liver diseases, ALF provides trusted support, resources
and education while advocating for public policy change and increased government funding for liver
disease research on Capitol Hill. ALF serves as a beacon for the 100 million Americans affected by
liver disease.

# Be a Liver of Life!

][171]

## Current Initiatives and Updates

American Liver Foundation provides current news and information on a variety of liver related topics
helping patients, friends and families affected by liver disease.
[

### American Liver Foundation Honors Congressman Jim Costa (D-CA) and Congressman Don Bacon (R-NE)
### with Congressional Champion Awards at its Liver Life Advocacy Summit in Washington, DC

][172]
American Liver Foundation’s (ALF) Liver Life Advocacy Summit was held in Washington, D.C. on April
21st and 22nd and brought together patients, caregivers and families from coast to coast to champion
legislative priorities for liver health and help the 100 million Americans affected by liver
disease.
[Learn More][173]
[

### ALF’s Official Charity Marathon Team Runs in 130th Annual Boston Marathon to Fight Liver Disease

][174]
American Liver Foundation (ALF) is proud to once again be a member of the 130th Boston Marathon®
presented by Bank of America, which takes place on Monday, April 20, 2026, at Hopkinton to Boston.
[Learn More][175]
[

### American Liver Foundation Elects David Frank as New Board Chair

][176]
American Liver Foundation (ALF) is excited to announce the election of David Frank as its new chair
of the board. David, who has served as Vice Chair of ALF’s board since March of 2025, is the Senior
Product Manager for Equities Cash & Derivatives at Wells Fargo Securities in NYC.
[Learn More][177]

# Find a Clinical Trial

Clinical trials are research studies that test how well new medical approaches work in people. Speak
with your doctor about the ongoing progress and results of these trials to get the most up-to-date
information on new treatments. Participating in a clinical trial is a great way to contribute to
curing, preventing, and treating liver disease and its complications. **[Start your search
here][178]** to find clinical trials that need people like you.

## Interested in learning more about clinical trials?

Clinical trials are research studies aimed at evaluating medical, surgical, or behavioral
interventions. They are a primary way for researchers to learn more about the safety and
effectiveness of investigational treatments. Check out our featured clinical trials for MASH/NASH
and Hepatocellular Carcinoma (HCC) by clicking below.

[Learn more][179]

## Signature Programs

[

### Think Liver Think Life

][188]
Think Liver Think Life™ is a national public health campaign which aims to ensure every American
understands their risk for liver disease, receives the appropriate screening and care coordination
and feels well-informed and supported throughout their liver journey.
[Visit Website][189]
[

## American Liver Foundation Living Donor Network

][190]
American Liver Foundation’s (ALF) Living Donor Network is the first-ever non-directed liver donor
database; it was created to connect individuals who wish to donate part of their liver with
transplant centers nationwide to help children and adults in need.
[Visit Website][191]
[

## Bili The Brave

][192]
Facing liver disease as a child can be a lonely process for both kids and parents alike, but not
anymore. American Liver Foundation (ALF) is proud to announce the launch of Bili the Brave™ for
children and families affected by biliary atresia (BA).
[Learn More][193]

## Signature Events

[

### Liver Life Walk

][194]
Liver Life Walk is a signature event of the American Liver Foundation (ALF). It allows people
affected by liver disease to come together to raise awareness and funds. It also gives them the
opportunity to support each other in a festive and inspiring environment.
[Visit Website][195]
[

### Liver Life Challenge

][196]
The Liver Life Challenge is the American Liver Foundation’s official endurance program, where
dedicated athletes across the country use their passion and commitment to go the extra mile for the
liver community.
[Visit Website][197]
[

### National Legacy Gala

][198]
The 50th Anniversary National Legacy Gala recognizes individuals and organizations who have made
outstanding contributions to the American Liver Foundation (ALF) and the liver community.
[Visit Website][199]

## Our Impact

We are focused on improving patient lives, increasing public awareness of liver disease, advancing
liver transplantation and funding cutting-edge liver disease research – we’re working every day to
help save lives.
As the largest organization focused on all liver diseases, ALF provides trusted support, resources
and education while advocating for public policy change and increased government funding for liver
disease research on Capitol Hill. ALF serves as a beacon for the 100 million Americans affected by
liver disease.

# Leading the Fight Against MASH

Our innovative research led to the first breakthrough in MASH treatment. And we’re just getting
started.

[More About Madrigal][24]
[Close]

###### COMPANY NEWS

[European Commission Grants Approval of Our Medicine. Read more][25]

Pam, patient advocate

[Jenn, living with MASH, gazes to the side and smiles gently.]

## Delivering a Breakthrough Treatment

Madrigal is a biopharmaceutical company focused on delivering novel therapeutics for metabolic
dysfunction-associated steatohepatitis (MASH), a serious liver disease with high unmet medical need.
Left untreated, MASH can lead to progressive liver scarring, cirrhosis, liver failure, liver cancer,
need for transplant and premature mortality. Our goal is to halt or reverse liver scarring
(fibrosis) and resolve MASH before patients experience the devastating complications of cirrhosis.

Madrigal’s ambitious research program led to the first U.S. Food and Drug Administration
(FDA)-approved treatment in MASH.

[Our Medicine][26]

## Shining a Light on MASH

## Shining a Light on MASH

Metabolic dysfunction-associated steatohepatitis (MASH), formerly known as nonalcoholic
steatohepatitis (NASH), is a serious form of fatty liver disease that occurs when fat in the liver
becomes toxic, damaging liver cells. The chronic and progressive nature of the disease can cause
significant damage over time, including inflammation and scarring, or fibrosis. Fibrosis can
progress quickly and be unpredictable, often resulting in cirrhosis and decompensated liver disease.

MASH is the leading cause of liver transplantation in the U.S. for women and is expected to soon
become the leading cause for men.

[More About MASH][27]

Proud of UAE
At Mediclinic Middle East we are #ProudOfUAE, The country’s progress is driven by the strength of
its people and their continued commitment to growth.
[Web Banner]
The Mediclinic App, Your Healthcare Companion
The all-new Mediclinic App brings together every aspect of your healthcare journey in one seamless
and secure platform. Designed around your needs, the health app combines trusted medical expertise
with smart digital convenience.
[Learn more…][97]
[Virtual_health-011]
Virtual Health Services
Virtual Health Service brings premium healthcare to your fingertips, built on the strength of a
trusted network of hospitals and clinics, and backed by personalised care coordination.
[Learn more…][98]

Perimenopause and Menopause Package
Your journey through perimenopause and menopause deserves expert support. Our specialised package
offers a personalised plan tailored to your unique needs. Starting from just AED 650, the package
includes consultation, hormonal testing and more.
[Learn more...][99]
[MP-Web Banner]
Well Woman Gynaecology Package
Stay one step ahead with our comprehensive Well Woman Gynaecology Package - designed to support your
overall health, hormonal balance and gynaecological wellbeing. The package includes specialist
consultation, hormone testing, pap smear and more for AED 1,624 only.
[Learn more...][100]

Corporate Health Checkup at Mediclinic
Boost employee health, engagement, and productivity with Mediclinic's customised health solutions.
[Learn more...][101]

MEDICLINIC WOMAN – A NEW APPROACH TO WOMEN’S HEALTH
Explore Mediclinic's expert women's health services, providing comprehensive care from routine exams
to specialised support, all with personalised and compassionate attention.
[Learn more! ][102]

# Home

Medtrition Middle East provides high quality medical foods that are clinically supported to achieve
the outcomes desired in a cost-effective way.  Whether it be Iraq, Saudi Arabia, Lebanon, or any
other Middle Eastern country, the medical food’s that Medtrition Middle East can provide to address
such things as renal and dialysis, protein and calorie malnutrition, pressure ulcers, wound healing,
bowel management and more are second to none.  Nestle, Hormel, FSMP, Juven, ProStat, Proteinex,

## We help people feel better.

All of our products are clinically supported and provide cost-effective solutions to address over 20
common conditions. Most important, the products deliver the outcomes you desire for your patients
and improve both staff and patient dignity without the use of unnecessary medications.

innovative and high-quality medicines. Minapharm’s expertise encompasses a wide range of medicines,

immediately sent to your email.

# [Over 200 generic drug dossiers for Africa and the Middle East][25]

[MORE …][26]

## [Your generic drug partner for local production][27]

[MORE …][28]

## [360° service from pharmaceutical raw materials to finished generic drugs][29]

[MORE …][30]

## Polypharma is your partner for a complete service in the production of generic drugs

## and supply of pharmaceutical raw material

 

**For 35 years**, Polypharma has been advising and supporting companies in **East, West and North
Africa** and the **Middle East** in the production of generic drugs.

We operate with existing companies or companies in construction. Thanks to our know-how, we advise
manufacturers wishing to expand their range of generics or investors looking for a partner who will
be able to guide them.

In addition, Polypharma assists its partners with dossier development, registrations, negotiations
with authorities and provides assistance on location.

[Please let us know your interest.][31]

## Our services at a glance
* [Dossier development][32]
* [Supply of pharmaceutical raw materials (APIs and excipients)][33]
* [Support in plant construction][34]
* [Advice in generics project planning][35]
* [Technical assistance for laboratory and validation batches][36]
* [Registration help][37]
* [Market-][38] and [feasibility studies][39]
* [Local service in Africa and the Middle East][40]

## Many years of experience in supporting generic drug manufacturers in Africa and the Middle East

## Product range of over 200 generic drug dossiers

Our product portfolio comprises more than 200 generic drug dossiers from the following areas:

* [Human medicine][41]
* [Veterinary medicine ][42]

## New molecules

In close cooperation with its partners and start-ups, **Polypharma is constantly looking for new
molecules** for the manufacture of:
* generics,
* food supplements and
* biosimilars

[Learn more by contacting us.][43]

## Support for investors in Africa and the Middle East in the production of generic drugs

In order to enable African and Middle Eastern countries to reduce imports of expensive (often
counterfeit) medicines, **Polypharma supports local entrepreneurs and investors in setting up their
own production facilities.**
**Our 360° service includes market analyses, feasibility studies, advice on the choice of a generic
product portfolio and production facilities.** We also guarantee the supply of pharmaceutical raw
materials.

[If you are interested please contact us.][44]

## Supply of pharmaceutical raw materials for Africa and the Middle East

Our raw materials are produced by internationally renowned manufacturers. We develop and use new
synthesis methods in order to be more competitive and ensure the best quality.

**We supply all the raw materials included in our dossiers, and many more, and advise you on
specific effects and pharmaceutical compositions. Depending on your requirements, we can adapt the
formulation of our technical dossiers by adapting the excipients.**

For more information, please click on the following link: [deliveries of pharmaceutical raw
materials][45]

Frequently Asked Questions
* [ Why should I book an eye exam with Poudre Valley Eyecare? ][44]
  
  At Poudre Valley Eyecare, our dedicated eye doctors offer the highest quality eye care with a
  professional and personal touch. Our eye doctors in Fort Collins will work with you using the
  latest advances in vision technology for a prescription that fits your vision needs and lifestyle.
  Our optometrists, together with our knowledgeable staff of technicians and highly skilled office
  professionals, we will be there for you every step of the way.
* [ Do I need an appointment? ][45]
  
  It’s rare, but we can take walk-ins if time permits at our Colorado optometry practice. However,
  for your convenience, you can book any of our services in advance at any time. Our eye doctors are
  just a call away at (970)-493-6360, or you can book an appointment online!
* [ Can you do color prescription contacts? ][46]
  
  Yes. Color contacts (colored contact lenses) come in a variety of colors and can be prescribed to
  suit your taste.
* [ Do you do LASIK surgery? ][47]
  
  We do not perform LASIK at PVE, but upon your visit with one of our optometrists you can ask to
  see if Lasik would be right for you.
* [ What should I bring to my eye exam? ][48]
  
  Please bring your current glasses or contact prescriptions, an ID, and your insurance information.
  Our eye care team will take care of the rest.
* [ What is the difference between an eye exam and a vision screening? ][49]
  
  An eye examination is a medical assessment that looks for common eye diseases or conditions. These
  exams might include the use of various diagnostic instruments, such as an ophthalmoscope to look
  at the retina and optic nerve fibers, a slit lamp to closely examine the front surface of the eye,
  and other equipment as needed to prescribe glasses or contacts to improve the vision for an
  individual. Vision screening is a series of tests to identify if an individual has a problem
  seeing. These tests can be set up in schools or public buildings to test if a child can see while
  at school or allow someone to get a drivers license to operate commercial vehicles.
* [ Is a contact lens exam different than an eye exam? ][50]
  
  There are some unique measurements required for getting either contact lenses or glasses. But the
  intent behind both is to assess eyesight and determine prescription. Talk to one of our eye
  doctors today to see what options would be best for you! Call (970)-493-6360!
* [ How do I know if my child needs glasses? ][51]
  
  Does your child have difficulty seeing words when reading or do they mistake objects when they are
  further away? If so, they may need glasses. If you’re not sure, it never hurts to have an
  [pediatric eye exam][52]! Poudre Valley Eyecare understands that your child’s eyesight is vital to
  their health and development. That’s why we’re committed to providing the best eye care possible
  for every phase of life–from infancy through adulthood. With cutting edge technology combined with
  decades of experience, our team offers world-class service personalized specifically for each
  individual’s needs.
  
  [Read why Back to school eye exams are so vital for your child.][53]
* [ Do you accept medicare? ][54]
  
  Yes, Poudre Valley Eyecare accepts[ Medicare for medical eye exams][55]. Contact us today to book
  an appointment with one of our eye doctors for a comprehensive eye exam.
* [ What does an eye doctor do? ][56]
  
  Eye doctors, including optometrists and ophthalmologists, are professionals trained to diagnose,
  treat, and manage vision problems and eye diseases. They conduct comprehensive eye exams,
  prescribe corrective lenses, and, in the case of ophthalmologists, perform eye surgeries for more
  complex conditions. Their role is crucial in maintaining eye health, preventing vision impairment,
  and providing specialized care for various eye conditions.
* [ When should I see an eye doctor? ][57]

Frequently Asked Questions
* [ Why should I book an eye exam with Poudre Valley Eyecare? ][44]
  
  At Poudre Valley Eyecare, our dedicated eye doctors offer the highest quality eye care with a
  professional and personal touch. Our eye doctors in Fort Collins will work with you using the
  latest advances in vision technology for a prescription that fits your vision needs and lifestyle.
  Our optometrists, together with our knowledgeable staff of technicians and highly skilled office
  professionals, we will be there for you every step of the way.
* [ Do I need an appointment? ][45]
  
  It’s rare, but we can take walk-ins if time permits at our Colorado optometry practice. However,
  for your convenience, you can book any of our services in advance at any time. Our eye doctors are
  just a call away at (970)-493-6360, or you can book an appointment online!
* [ Can you do color prescription contacts? ][46]
  
  Yes. Color contacts (colored contact lenses) come in a variety of colors and can be prescribed to
  suit your taste.
* [ Do you do LASIK surgery? ][47]
  
  We do not perform LASIK at PVE, but upon your visit with one of our optometrists you can ask to
  see if Lasik would be right for you.
* [ What should I bring to my eye exam? ][48]
  
  Please bring your current glasses or contact prescriptions, an ID, and your insurance information.
  Our eye care team will take care of the rest.
* [ What is the difference between an eye exam and a vision screening? ][49]
  
  An eye examination is a medical assessment that looks for common eye diseases or conditions. These
  exams might include the use of various diagnostic instruments, such as an ophthalmoscope to look
  at the retina and optic nerve fibers, a slit lamp to closely examine the front surface of the eye,
  and other equipment as needed to prescribe glasses or contacts to improve the vision for an
  individual. Vision screening is a series of tests to identify if an individual has a problem
  seeing. These tests can be set up in schools or public buildings to test if a child can see while
  at school or allow someone to get a drivers license to operate commercial vehicles.
* [ Is a contact lens exam different than an eye exam? ][50]
  
  There are some unique measurements required for getting either contact lenses or glasses. But the
  intent behind both is to assess eyesight and determine prescription. Talk to one of our eye
  doctors today to see what options would be best for you! Call (970)-493-6360!
* [ How do I know if my child needs glasses? ][51]
  
  Does your child have difficulty seeing words when reading or do they mistake objects when they are
  further away? If so, they may need glasses. If you’re not sure, it never hurts to have an
  [pediatric eye exam][52]! Poudre Valley Eyecare understands that your child’s eyesight is vital to
  their health and development. That’s why we’re committed to providing the best eye care possible
  for every phase of life–from infancy through adulthood. With cutting edge technology combined with
  decades of experience, our team offers world-class service personalized specifically for each
  individual’s needs.
  
  [Read why Back to school eye exams are so vital for your child.][53]
* [ Do you accept medicare? ][54]
  
  Yes, Poudre Valley Eyecare accepts[ Medicare for medical eye exams][55]. Contact us today to book
  an appointment with one of our eye doctors for a comprehensive eye exam.
* [ What does an eye doctor do? ][56]
  
  Eye doctors, including optometrists and ophthalmologists, are professionals trained to diagnose,
  treat, and manage vision problems and eye diseases. They conduct comprehensive eye exams,
  prescribe corrective lenses, and, in the case of ophthalmologists, perform eye surgeries for more
  complex conditions. Their role is crucial in maintaining eye health, preventing vision impairment,
  and providing specialized care for various eye conditions.
* [ When should I see an eye doctor? ][57]
  
  You should see an eye doctor for regular eye exams to maintain eye health and ensure your vision
  is optimal, typically once every one to two years depending on your age, risk factors, and if you
  wear corrective lenses. Additionally, you should schedule a visit if you experience any changes in
  vision, such as blurriness, difficulty seeing at night, eye strain, or if you notice symptoms like
  flashes of light, increased floaters, or pain and redness in the eyes. These could be signs of eye
  conditions or diseases that require prompt attention.

Walter® Healthcare is one of India’s leading pharmaceutical CDMO / CMO. Backed by personnel with
over 25 years of expertise in the pharmaceutical industry, Walter's strategic business areas spread
across generics, APIs, nutraceuticals, cosmeceuticals, custom pharmaceutical services, and branded
generics. The company is widely recognised for its strengths in manufacturing turn-around-time,
efficacy, service, and, new product additions, explorations in new therapeutic arenas, and
commercialisation of a wide range of products. Pharma Manufacturer, Pharma Company, Pharma PCD


Walter has 5 state-of-the-art manufacturing facilities strategically structured nationwide, approved
by stringent global regulatory authorities. Our own-brands portfolio includes 800 plus products
encompassing major therapeutic categories such as Cardiovascular, Neurology, Psychiatric, Hepatitis,
Gastroenterology, Respiratory & COPD, Rheumatology, Nephrology, Urology, Diabetes, Hepatology, and
Immunology, etc.


We’re not just another factory. We’re a Contract Development and Manufacturing Organization (CDMO)
built for speed, compliance, and scale. From oral solids and liquids to injectables and
nutraceuticals, we offer full-spectrum pharmaceutical manufacturing under one roof — backed by
GLP-certified labs, end-to-end quality systems, and audit-ready infrastructure.

 

Whether you’re a startup brand, a scaling MSME, or a public-listed pharma company looking for a
reliable CMO, Walter® is engineered to be your backend execution partner — not just a vendor.

 

 

## 🛠️ What We Offer

* WHO-GMP Certified Manufacturing Units
  
  For tablets, capsules, syrups, ointments, sachets, and injectables — fully licensed and
  export-compliant.
* GLP-Compliant In-House Laboratory (LabTrust™)
  
  Complete testing capabilities: ICH stability, endotoxins, microbial limits, preservative efficacy,
  and more.
* Aseptic Injectable & Nutraceutical Divisions
  
  With lyophilization, cleanroom tech, and specialized manufacturing lines — ensuring safety,
  sterility, and scalability.
* Walter® PlantSure™ Framework
  
  Our in-house quality philosophy that ensures every batch meets not just compliance, but
  consistency.
* 130,000+ sq. ft. Across 3 Facilities in Punjab & Himachal
  
  Built to handle high-volume demand with low MOQs, high agility, and 24/7 audit readiness.
* Turnkey Manufacturing Support
  
  Including formulation, packaging, licensing, testing, documentation, and dispatch — all under one
  point of contact.

 

 

## 🌐 Who We Work With

 
* Generic Pharma Companies (India & Emerging Markets)
* Public-Listed Mid-Sized Pharma Brands
* Distributors & Exporters (Semi-Regulated/Unregulated Countries)
* Nutraceutical, Ayurvedic & D2C Healthcare Brands
* Government Supply Tenders (upon request)

 

 

## 🤝 Why Choose Walter®

 
* Low MOQs, fast turnarounds
* Radical transparency and accountability
* No overpromises — just high-performance execution
* Real photos, real infrastructure, real compliance

encompassing major therapeutic categories such as Cardiovascular, Neurology, Psychiatric, Hepatitis,
Gastroenterology, Respiratory & COPD, Rheumatology, Nephrology, Urology, Diabetes, Hepatology, and

We’re not just another factory. We’re a Contract Development and Manufacturing Organization (CDMO)
built for speed, compliance, and scale. From oral solids and liquids to injectables and
nutraceuticals, we offer full-spectrum pharmaceutical manufacturing under one roof — backed by
GLP-certified labs, end-to-end quality systems, and audit-ready infrastructure.

reliable CMO, Walter® is engineered to be your backend execution partner — not just a vendor.

  With lyophilization, cleanroom tech, and specialized manufacturing lines — ensuring safety,
  sterility, and scalability.

  Our in-house quality philosophy that ensures every batch meets not just compliance, but
  consistency.

  Built to handle high-volume demand with low MOQs, high agility, and 24/7 audit readiness.

  Including formulation, packaging, licensing, testing, documentation, and dispatch — all under one
